title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or drafter (Werribee)
content_text: No advertised vacancy. moodieengineering.com.au (home, about, contact read 5 Oct 2026 AEDT) has no careers page or job listing; SEEK search for Moodie (30 days) shows no Moodie & Associates advert. Site: civil design, planning and construction management for subdivisions, townhouses and masterplanned communities across Victoria and Queensland; established by Tony Moodie in Melbourne in 1985; Melbourne office 3/27 Synnot St, Werribee VIC 3030; projects include Coburns Road, Melton South (75-lot residential subdivision, civil design and documentation) and Palm Lake Resort, Truganina. Email published on every page: tony@moodieengineering.com.au.
apply_instructions: Speculative enquiry by email to tony@moodieengineering.com.au (founder's business email published by the employer on its home, about and contact pages).
